result.question: What happened to the young man who fell out of the window while Paul was speaking?

readings.answer: He was still alive (after Paul’s intervention).

assessments.reason: Acts 20:9 says he “fell from the third story and was picked up dead,” so stating he was picked up dead captures a valid part of what happened after the fall, though it omits the later declaration of life.
Acts 20:10 records Paul saying, “He is still alive!” after embracing him, so emphasizing that outcome is supported, though it omits the initial being picked up dead.
